signs.title: Cinnabar Island
lines: Cinnabar Island — where the ocean meets the volcano.
Rest at the Pokémon Center, and stay on the marked paths around the volcano.

signs.title: Cinnabar Research Lab
lines: Researchers study Pokémon fossils and the island’s volcanic environment.

signs.title: Cinnabar Island Pokémon Gym
lines: Leader: Blaine. A Gym devoted to Fire-type Pokémon.
